files.bot.json: What the ModWarden Suite bot says inside Discord: welcome and leave messages, level-ups, birthdays, live stream alerts, modmail replies, rank and welcome cards, and short replies to commands. Read by server members, often on phones. Friendly, short and plain, using the informal "you" where your language has one. Discord formatting (**bold**, links) and {placeholders} must be kept. Some strings are drawn on images (rank card, welcome card) and have tight limits.
files.panel.json: The ModWarden Suite web panel at mwsbot.app, where a server's staff set the bot up: the side menu, page names and common buttons. Read by moderators and server admins on desktop and phone. Use the same words Discord uses in your language for Discord things (server, channel, role, member, timeout, ban). Menu items and buttons have little room: keep them about as short as the English.

welcome.message.note: Posted in the server when a new member joins. {user} pings the new member, {server} is the server's name, {memberCount} is a number such as 1,284. Server admins can replace this text with their own.

welcome.cardTitle.note: Drawn on the welcome card image, small, above the new member's name. One word.

welcome.cardTo.note: Drawn on the welcome card image under the member's name. {server} is the server's name; it is cut short with … if the line is too long.

welcome.cardMember.note: Drawn on the welcome card image, the last line. {memberCount} is a number such as 1,284: which member they are.

leave.message.note: Posted when a member leaves. {username} is their name as plain text (not a ping), {server} the server's name, {memberCount} how many members are left.

levels.levelUp.note: Posted when a member reaches a new level. {user} pings them, {level} is a number.

levels.newRole.note: Added on a new line under the level-up message when the level gives the member a reward role. {role} is the role's name.

levels.noXpYou.note: Reply to /rank when the member asking has no XP yet.

levels.noXpThem.note: Reply to /rank about someone else who has no XP yet. {name} is their name.

levels.off.note: Reply to /rank or /leaderboard when the server has not switched levels on.

rankCard.rank.note: Drawn on the rank card image in capitals, beside the member's position on the leaderboard (#4). One short word in capitals.

rankCard.level.note: Drawn on the rank card image in capitals, beside the member's level number. One short word in capitals.

rankCard.total.note: Drawn on the rank card's bottom line. {xp} is the member's total experience points, such as 15,200.

rankCard.week.note: Drawn on the rank card's bottom line. {xp} is the experience points earned since Monday.

rankCard.streak.note: Drawn on the rank card's bottom line. {days} is a number of days in a row the member has chatted (2 or more).

rankCard.updated.note: Reply to /rankcard set, above a picture of the member's new rank card.

rankCard.reset.note: Reply to /rankcard reset: the member's card uses the server's style again.

birthday.message.note: Posted on a member's birthday. {user} pings them. Server admins can replace this text.

live.isLive.note: Top line of a live stream alert in Discord. {name} is the streamer's name, {platform} is Twitch, Kick, YouTube Live or TikTok LIVE (never translated).

live.wasLive.note: The same alert's top line once the stream has ended. {name} and {platform} as above.

live.playing.note: Label before the game or category being streamed, such as Just Chatting. A label, not a sentence.

live.viewers.note: Label before the number of people watching the stream.

live.ended.note: Small footer on a live alert after the stream has finished.

modmail.staffTeam.note: The sender's name on replies from staff to a member's private message (modmail). Staff stay anonymous, so it names the team, never one person.

errors.proNeeded.note: Shown when someone uses a feature their server's plan does not include. Keep "ModWarden Suite Pro", "Settings › Plan" and "mwsbot.app"; use the panel's own translations of Settings and Plan.

nav.overview.note: Section name in the panel's narrow left rail, under an icon: the dashboard and guides.

nav.inbox.note: Section name in the left rail: modmail, appeals, applications and role requests waiting for staff.

nav.moderation.note: Section name in the left rail: warnings, bans, timeouts and kicks.

nav.protection.note: Section name in the left rail: spam filter, honeypot, raid guard, blocked links and verification.

nav.records.note: Section name in the left rail: the audit log, user lookup and invites.

nav.reports.note: Section name in the left rail: server reports and staff activity.

nav.community.note: Section name in the left rail: messages, levels, welcomes, YouTube, TikTok and live alerts.

nav.system.note: Section name in the left rail: settings, bot status, feedback, help and preferences.

nav.search.note: Button at the bottom of the left rail that opens a search of every setting.

nav.modmail.note: Menu item: private conversations between members and staff, held through the bot. Many languages keep the word Modmail.

nav.appeals.note: Menu item: members asking for a ban or warning to be looked at again.

nav.applications.note: Menu item: forms members fill in, such as applying to become a moderator.

nav.roleRequests.note: Menu item: members asking staff for a Discord role.

nav.warnings.note: Menu item: the list of warnings given to members.

nav.bans.note: Menu item: the list of bans. Use Discord's word for ban.

nav.timeouts.note: Menu item: the list of timeouts. Use Discord's word for timeout (temporarily muting a member).

nav.kicks.note: Menu item: the list of kicks (removing a member, who can rejoin). Use Discord's word for kick.

nav.escalation.note: Menu item: rules that time out or ban a member automatically after a number of warnings.

nav.spamFilter.note: Menu item: removes spam such as mass mentions and repeated messages.

nav.honeypot.note: Menu item: a trap channel where anyone who posts is banned, catching spam bots and hacked accounts.

nav.raidGuard.note: Menu item: alerts when many accounts join at once (a raid), and lockdown.

nav.blockedLinks.note: Menu item: websites whose links are removed from messages.

nav.verification.note: Menu item: new members confirm they are a real person before they can talk.

nav.auditLog.note: Menu item: a record of everything that happened in the server and everything staff did.

nav.userLookup.note: Menu item: look up one member's history.

nav.invites.note: Menu item: which invite links members joined with.

nav.serverReports.note: Menu item: charts of the server's activity.

nav.staffActivity.note: Menu item: what each staff member has done.

nav.sendMessage.note: Menu item: post a message in a channel as the bot. An action: send (verb) a message.

nav.suggestions.note: Menu item: ideas members suggest and vote on.

nav.giveaways.note: Menu item: prize draws members enter with a button.

nav.events.note: Menu item: upcoming community events members sign up for.

nav.levels.note: Menu item: experience points (XP) and levels members earn by chatting.

nav.reactionRoles.note: Menu item: members give themselves roles by pressing buttons or reactions.

nav.welcomer.note: Menu item: the welcome and leave messages, birthdays and welcome cards.

nav.communityChannels.note: Menu item: counting, story, emoji, starboard and server stats channels.

nav.youtube.note: Menu item: new YouTube uploads announced in Discord. YouTube is a brand: do not translate.

nav.tiktok.note: Menu item: new TikTok videos announced in Discord. TikTok is a brand: do not translate.

nav.feeds.note: Menu item: new posts from Reddit and RSS feeds announced in Discord. Reddit and RSS are names: do not translate.

nav.liveAlerts.note: Menu item: posts when a streamer goes live on Twitch, Kick, YouTube or TikTok.

nav.settings.note: Menu item: the bot's settings for the whole server, changed by its staff. Not the same as Preferences.

nav.botStatus.note: Menu item: whether the bot is online and working.

nav.sendFeedback.note: Menu item: report a problem or suggest a feature to the bot's makers. An action (verb).

nav.preferences.note: Menu item: one staff member's own panel choices (colours, text size). Not the same as Settings.

nav.switchServer.note: Small link under the server's name at the top of the menu: choose another server. An action (verb).

nav.signOut.note: Small button at the bottom of the menu: sign out of the panel. An action (verb).

common.save.note: Button at the bottom of a settings card. An action: save the settings changed above.

common.saved.note: Shown next to the Save button after saving. A state: they have been saved.

common.loading.note: Shown while a page is loading.

common.on.note: Next to an on/off switch when it is on. Very little room.

common.off.note: Next to an on/off switch when it is off. Very little room.

common.resetToDefault.note: Link at the top of a settings card: put every setting in the card back to how it started. An action.

common.cancel.note: Button that closes a box without doing anything.

common.remove.note: Button that removes an item from a list, such as a streamer or a channel. An action (verb).

common.add.note: Button that adds what was typed to a list. An action (verb).

common.noPing.note: First choice in a list of roles to ping (notify): nobody is pinged.

common.chooseChannel.note: First line of a list of Discord channels, before one is chosen.

common.viewOnly.note: Shown instead of the Save button to staff who can see a page but not change it.
